text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Mihono 
Bourbon, we came across a festival at a 
shrine along the way.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Crowd density is five times higher than 
usual. In other words, it appears to be 
"bustling."
choice_data_list: Curious?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...No, I was just observing which shops 
have the highest density. Since it's 
unstored data.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It seems the yakisoba stand has the 
highest crowd density. Even though it's 
home cooking that one could easily eat at 
home.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Stomach activated by visual input. 
Judged as a reflex action.
choice_data_list: Let's check out the food stalls!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. If that is Master's wish, I 
shall accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch*... *gulp*...
choice_data_list: Is it tasty?
Is it good?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. True to its name, it's 'Piping-Hot 
Yakisoba.' ...Yet, for some reason, it's 
more flavorful than usual.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the other stall foods are like 
this as well... ............*Gulp*.

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Guy
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, step right up! How about 
working off some of that food at the 
shooting gallery and winning grand prizes!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Guy
text_block_list.text:
The main attraction is the elusive 
"All-You-Can-Grab Prize Ticket"! Whoever 
you're with is guaranteed to be thrilled~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master, hunger has been resolved. Next, 
please grant me permission to fulfill your 
own desires.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It seems the shooting gallery has a prize 
that would serve perfectly as a token of 
appreciation for Master's kindness.
choice_data_list: Wanna try the shooting gallery, then?
Shall we try the shooting gallery, then?

No, let's eat our way through the other 
stalls too

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It seems the shooting gallery has a prize 
that would serve perfectly as a token of 
appreciation for Master's kindness.
choice_data_list: Wanna try the shooting gallery, then?
Shall we try the shooting gallery, then?

No, let's eat our way through the other 
stalls too

text_block_list.text:
And so, we began shooting at the target 
gallery in hopes of knocking down the 
"All-You-Can-Take Prize Voucher," but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, it didn't drop again. You've failed 
10 times already, you sure are persistent, 
little lady.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Range adjusted by +5mm. Adding 3 degrees 
to the launch angle... recalculating 
maximum ballistic trajectory.
choice_data_list: There's a curfew, so let's head home soon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. No problem. I will drop 
off on the next one."
(Swish! Thud)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Target neutralized.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh~~!! It fell just like you said it 
would~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Guy
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! You completely beat me, missy! Take 
whatever you want, as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...That is what was said. Master, what 
would you like?"
choice_data_list: Pick something Bourbon likes!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Mine...? ...Things that I like.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. Please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I thought these would be perfect for us, 
so I picked matching ones. Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...I hope it suits Master's hands.

Taking the prize out of the box, I gently 
held it in my hands...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
How is it? How does the resistance on that 
hand grip feel?
choice_data_list: Looking good...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad. Now we can train and push 
each other to greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...And with that, mission complete.

We made our way back to the academy while 
training with our matching handgrips...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That would just be fulfilling my own wish 
and benefiting me alone. It wouldn't serve 
as a proper expression of gratitude to 
Master.
choice_data_list: That's what I'm hoping for.
That is my hope.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My hope is... Master's hope...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Then I shall eat with all 
my might to honor those feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Commencing Operation: Conquer the Food 
Stalls. First up, that taiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch*, *mun—*

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: W-What's the matter?
W-What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Reporting. The flavor exceeded my data 
by such a degree that my cognitive 
circuits temporarily short-circuited."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Special cooking, seasoning... neither can 
be confirmed. Assessed as ordinary 
taiyaki."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Just like with the yakisoba... why is this 
so delicious and lifting my spirits so 
much?
choice_data_list:
Just because it's fun, or something like 
that?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I recall seeing that in the data 
before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Feelings and taste are linked together. In 
other words, "happiness is the finest 
seasoning of all."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master, next let us have okonomiyaki. I 
am curious to see how delicious it can 
truly be.

Even after that, Mihono Bourbon kept 
eating food stall dishes...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: *burp*... Cotton candy finished.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
With this, all food stall dishes have been 
conquered. Energy replenishment is also 
complete.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...How about you, Master? Was I able to 
fulfill your wishes?
choice_data_list: Of course! That was so much fun!
Of course! It was a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Well then... Mission complete. Saving to 
memory.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The completion of my mission, and... this 
delicious taste I shared with Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Just remembering it... feels like I could 
run up any slope, no matter how far."

The street stall food not only replenished 
Mihono Bourbon's energy... it also 
completely filled her heart.
